description: This Java source file defines an abstract class ChewbaccaUncaughtExceptionHandler that implements the UncaughtExceptionHandler interface. It handles uncaught exceptions by logging, creating crash reports, archiving crash details, and sending notifications about crashes within an Android application, specifically for the 'AnySoftKeyboard' project.

classes.name: ChewbaccaUncaughtExceptionHandler
classes.description: An abstract class that handles uncaught exceptions in an Android app, logs crash details, archives crash reports, and sends crash notifications.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a notification about a crash, including crash details and a link to report.
